name: Discord Bot (discord.js)
description: discord.js v14 bot. The token is never asked while creating the server: the bot starts with an empty .env and you add DISCORD_TOKEN later under Startup & Env, exactly like Pterodactyl.

files..env:
DISCORD_TOKEN=
# Add other secrets here. Only the panel owner (admin) can read this file.

variables.label: Discord bot token
variables.description: Leave blank while creating. Add it later under Startup & Env, exactly like Pterodactyl.
